<style id="wp-custom-css">
.main-content {
    padding: 85px 0 0;
    background-color: #2b49b7;
}
.main-content * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    margin: 0;
}
.main-content h1 {
    margin: 120px 0 60px;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 3.75rem;
    text-align: center;
    line-height: 1;
}
.main-content h1 span {
    color: #c7ed44;
    font-size: 4rem;
    font-family: Atma;
}

.contact-box {
    max-width: 1280px;
    width: 88%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 75px;
    border-radius: 30px;
    background-color: #fff;
}
.contact-form {
    width: 100%;
}
.contact-form .form-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    gap: 2rem;
    margin-bottom: 3rem;
}
.contact-form .form-row:last-child {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.contact-form .form-full {
    flex: 1;
}
.contact-form .form-col {
    width: 50%;
}
.contact-form input.normal,
.contact-form select,
.contact-form textarea {
    width: 100%;
    height: 70px;
    padding: 15px 30px;
    border: 1px solid #e8ebf0;
    border-radius: 15px;
    background-color: #e8ebf0;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-family: inherit;
}
.contact-form input:focus,
.contact-form textarea:focus {
    border-color: #7d98a1;
    outline: none;
}
.contact-form input::placeholder,
.contact-form textarea::placeholder {
    color: #69668a;
}
.contact-form .error-info {
    color: #f00 !important;
}
.contact-form textarea {
    height: 10em;
}
.contact-form button {
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 20px 80px;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 15px;
    background-color: #c7ec44;
    color: #281e63;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: bold;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.contact-info {
    max-width: 1280px;
    width: 88%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 1px 0;
    color: #fff;
    text-align: center;
}
.contact-info h2 {
    margin: 200px 0 60px;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 4em;
}
.contact-details {
    padding: 40px 0 140px;
    font-size: 1.6em;
}
.contact-map {
    overflow: hidden;
    width: 100%;
    height: 600px;
    border-radius: 30px;
}
.contact-button {
    display: inline-block;
    margin: 40px auto;
    padding: 20px 40px;
    border-radius: 15px;
    background-color: #c7ec44;
    color: #281e63;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: bold;
    line-height: 1;
    text-decoration: none !important;
}
.contact-button:hover {
    color: #281e63;
}

.btn-loader {
    display: none;
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    margin-right: 6px;
    border: 3px solid #14bf8b;
    border-bottom-color: transparent;
    border-radius: 50%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    animation: rotation 1s linear infinite;
    vertical-align: -5px;
}
.running .btn-loader {
    display: inline-block;
}
.contact-form button.running {
    padding-top: 24px;
    padding-bottom: 24px;
}
@keyframes rotation {
    0% {
        transform: rotate(0deg);
    }
    100% {
        transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
}
.inline-message {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    z-index: 1;
    min-width: 14em;
    padding: 1em 2em;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
    border-radius: 0.5em;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    background-color: #45a049;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1.2em;
}
.inline-message.showing {
    display: block;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
    .main-content h1,
    .contact-info h2 {
        font-size: 2.5rem;
    }
    .main-content h1 span {
        font-size: 2.75rem;
    }
    .contact-box {
        padding-bottom: 3rem;
    }
    .contact-form .form-row {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 3rem;
    }
    .contact-form .form-col {
        width: 100%;
    }
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
    .main-content h1,
    .contact-info h2 {
        margin: 1em 0;
        font-size: 2em;
    }
    .main-content h1 span {
        font-size: 2.1rem;
    }
    .contact-info h2 {
        margin-top: 60px;
    }
    .contact-box {
        padding: 3rem 25px;
    }
    .contact-info {
        margin-top: 30px;
    }
    .contact-details {
        padding: 30px;
        font-size: 1.2em;
    }

<style id="wp-custom-css">
.main-content {
    padding: 85px 0 0;
    background-color: #2b49b7;
}
.main-content * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    margin: 0;
}
.main-content h1 {
    margin: 120px 0 60px;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 3.75rem;
    text-align: center;
    line-height: 1;
}
.main-content h1 span {
    color: #c7ed44;
    font-size: 4rem;
    font-family: Atma;
}

.contact-box {
    max-width: 1280px;
    width: 88%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 75px;
    border-radius: 30px;
    background-color: #fff;
}
.contact-form {
    width: 100%;
}
.contact-form .form-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    gap: 2rem;
    margin-bottom: 3rem;
}
.contact-form .form-row:last-child {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.contact-form .form-full {
    flex: 1;
}
.contact-form .form-col {
    width: 50%;
}
.contact-form input.normal,
.contact-form select,
.contact-form textarea {
    width: 100%;
    height: 70px;
    padding: 15px 30px;
    border: 1px solid #e8ebf0;

}

    padding: 20px 40px;
    border-radius: 15px;
    background-color: #c7ec44;
    color: #281e63;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: bold;
    line-height: 1;
    text-decoration: none !important;
}
.contact-button:hover {

.btn-loader {

    border: 3px solid #14bf8b;
    border-bottom-color: transparent;
    border-radius: 50%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    animation: rotation 1s linear infinite;
    vertical-align: -5px;
}
.running .btn-loader {
    display: inline-block;
}
.contact-form button.running {
    padding-top: 24px;
    padding-bottom: 24px;
}
@keyframes rotation {
    0% {
        transform: rotate(0deg);

    100% {
        transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
}
.inline-message {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;

    min-width: 14em;
    padding: 1em 2em;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
    border-radius: 0.5em;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    background-color: #45a049;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1.2em;
}

<style id="wp-custom-css">
.main-content {
    padding: 85px 0 0;
    background-color: #2b49b7;
}
.main-content * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    margin: 0;
}
.main-content h1 {
    margin: 120px 0 60px;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 3.75rem;
    text-align: center;
    line-height: 1;
}
.main-content h1 span {
    color: #c7ed44;
    font-size: 4rem;
    font-family: Atma;
}

.contact-box {
    max-width: 1280px;
    width: 88%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 75px;
    border-radius: 30px;
    background-color: #fff;
}
.contact-form {
    width: 100%;
}
.contact-form .form-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    gap: 2rem;
    margin-bottom: 3rem;
}
.contact-form .form-row:last-child {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.contact-form .form-full {
    flex: 1;
}
.contact-form .form-col {
    width: 50%;
}
.contact-form input.normal,
.contact-form select,
.contact-form textarea {
    width: 100%;
    height: 70px;
    padding: 15px 30px;
    border: 1px solid #e8ebf0;
    border-radius: 15px;
    background-color: #e8ebf0;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-family: inherit;
}
.contact-form input:focus,
.contact-form textarea:focus {
    border-color: #7d98a1;
    outline: none;
}
.contact-form input::placeholder,
.contact-form textarea::placeholder {
    color: #69668a;
}
.contact-form .error-info {
    color: #f00 !important;
}
.contact-form textarea {
    height: 10em;
}
.contact-form button {
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 20px 80px;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 15px;
    background-color: #c7ec44;
    color: #281e63;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: bold;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.contact-info {
    max-width: 1280px;
    width: 88%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 1px 0;
    color: #fff;
    text-align: center;
}
.contact-info h2 {
    margin: 200px 0 60px;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 4em;
}
.contact-details {
    padding: 40px 0 140px;
    font-size: 1.6em;
}
.contact-map {
    overflow: hidden;
    width: 100%;
    height: 600px;
    border-radius: 30px;
}
.contact-button {
    display: inline-block;
    margin: 40px auto;
    padding: 20px 40px;
    border-radius: 15px;
    background-color: #c7ec44;
    color: #281e63;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: bold;
    line-height: 1;
    text-decoration: none !important;
}
.contact-button:hover {
    color: #281e63;
}

.btn-loader {
    display: none;
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    margin-right: 6px;
    border: 3px solid #14bf8b;
    border-bottom-color: transparent;
    border-radius: 50%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    animation: rotation 1s linear infinite;
    vertical-align: -5px;
}
.running .btn-loader {
    display: inline-block;
}
.contact-form button.running {
    padding-top: 24px;
    padding-bottom: 24px;
}
@keyframes rotation {
    0% {
        transform: rotate(0deg);
    }
    100% {
        transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
}
.inline-message {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    z-index: 1;
    min-width: 14em;
    padding: 1em 2em;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
    border-radius: 0.5em;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    background-color: #45a049;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1.2em;
}
.inline-message.showing {
    display: block;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
    .main-content h1,
    .contact-info h2 {
        font-size: 2.5rem;
    }
    .main-content h1 span {
        font-size: 2.75rem;
    }
    .contact-box {
        padding-bottom: 3rem;
    }
    .contact-form .form-row {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 3rem;
    }
    .contact-form .form-col {
        width: 100%;
    }
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
    .main-content h1,
    .contact-info h2 {
        margin: 1em 0;
        font-size: 2em;
    }
    .main-content h1 span {
        font-size: 2.1rem;
    }
    .contact-info h2 {
        margin-top: 60px;
    }
    .contact-box {
        padding: 3rem 25px;
    }
    .contact-info {
        margin-top: 30px;
    }
    .contact-details {
        padding: 30px;
        font-size: 1.2em;
    }
}

<style id="wp-custom-css">
.main-content {
    padding: 85px 0 0;
    background-color: #2b49b7;
}
.main-content * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    margin: 0;
}
.main-content h1 {
    margin: 120px 0 60px;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 3.75rem;
    text-align: center;
    line-height: 1;
}
.main-content h1 span {
    color: #c7ed44;
    font-size: 4rem;
    font-family: Atma;
}

.contact-box {
    max-width: 1280px;
    width: 88%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 75px;
    border-radius: 30px;
    background-color: #fff;
}
.contact-form {
    width: 100%;
}
.contact-form .form-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    gap: 2rem;
    margin-bottom: 3rem;
}
.contact-form .form-row:last-child {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.contact-form .form-full {
    flex: 1;
}
.contact-form .form-col {
    width: 50%;
}
.contact-form input.normal,
.contact-form select,
.contact-form textarea {
    width: 100%;
    height: 70px;
    padding: 15px 30px;
    border: 1px solid #e8ebf0;
    border-radius: 15px;
    background-color: #e8ebf0;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-family: inherit;
}
.contact-form input:focus,
.contact-form textarea:focus {
    border-color: #7d98a1;
    outline: none;
}
.contact-form input::placeholder,
.contact-form textarea::placeholder {
    color: #69668a;
}
.contact-form .error-info {
    color: #f00 !important;
}
.contact-form textarea {
    height: 10em;
}
.contact-form button {
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 20px 80px;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 15px;
    background-color: #c7ec44;
    color: #281e63;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: bold;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.contact-info {
    max-width: 1280px;
    width: 88%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 1px 0;
    color: #fff;
    text-align: center;
}
.contact-info h2 {
    margin: 200px 0 60px;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 4em;
}
.contact-details {
    padding: 40px 0 140px;
    font-size: 1.6em;
}
.contact-map {
    overflow: hidden;
    width: 100%;
    height: 600px;
    border-radius: 30px;
}
.contact-button {
    display: inline-block;
    margin: 40px auto;
    padding: 20px 40px;
    border-radius: 15px;
    background-color: #c7ec44;
    color: #281e63;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: bold;
    line-height: 1;
    text-decoration: none !important;
}
.contact-button:hover {
    color: #281e63;
}

.btn-loader {
    display: none;
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    margin-right: 6px;
    border: 3px solid #14bf8b;
    border-bottom-color: transparent;
    border-radius: 50%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    animation: rotation 1s linear infinite;
    vertical-align: -5px;
}
.running .btn-loader {
    display: inline-block;
}
.contact-form button.running {
    padding-top: 24px;
    padding-bottom: 24px;
}
@keyframes rotation {
    0% {
        transform: rotate(0deg);
    }
    100% {
        transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
}
.inline-message {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    z-index: 1;
    min-width: 14em;
    padding: 1em 2em;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
    border-radius: 0.5em;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    background-color: #45a049;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1.2em;
}
.inline-message.showing {
    display: block;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
    .main-content h1,
    .contact-info h2 {
        font-size: 2.5rem;
    }
    .main-content h1 span {
        font-size: 2.75rem;
    }
    .contact-box {
        padding-bottom: 3rem;
    }
    .contact-form .form-row {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 3rem;
    }
    .contact-form .form-col {
        width: 100%;
    }
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
    .main-content h1,
    .contact-info h2 {
        margin: 1em 0;
        font-size: 2em;
    }
    .main-content h1 span {
        font-size: 2.1rem;
    }
    .contact-info h2 {
        margin-top: 60px;
    }
    .contact-box {
        padding: 3rem 25px;
    }
    .contact-info {
        margin-top: 30px;
    }
    .contact-details {
        padding: 30px;
        font-size: 1.2em;
    }
}
